task.title: Check what the page sees in an emulated browser

context.p: Run these steps in headless Chrome set to dark mode, German, Berlin time, a 2x display, reduced motion, and a fixed clock.

step.cmd: Start at the test site's home page.
Check that the page prefers the dark color scheme and reduced motion.
Check that the page's language is de-DE and its time zone is Europe/Berlin.
Check that the device pixel ratio is 2, and that the clock reads 3 December 2026, 09:00 UTC.
